description: Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC? Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. Pay And Benefits Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location Pension / Retirement benefits Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). The Impact You Will Have In This Role The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met. Your Primary Responsibilities Safeguard a global post-trade platform — Your test automation will directly protect the reliability of a system used daily by investment managers, broker/dealers, and custodian banks worldwide, where a single defect can carry real financial and regulatory consequences. Raise the quality bar across the SDLC — You will embed quality earlier and deeper into delivery, shifting testing left and enabling faster, more confident releases without compromising stability. Accelerate delivery through AI-augmented testing — By leveraging AI for test generation, self-healing UI locators, and reusable automation assets, you'll reduce manual test effort, shorten regression cycles, and free the team to focus on higher-value work. De-risk a major platform modernization — Your validation of Oracle-to-PostgreSQL database migrations will ensure data integrity and functional parity as the platform modernizes, protecting the business from migration-related regressions. Elevate the engineering team — Through technical leadership and mentorship, you'll uplift the QA engineering team's skills, establish automation best practices, and create a durable culture of quality ownership. Enable full-stack confidence — By driving coverage across UI, API, database, and integration layers of a multi-service containerized architecture, you'll give stakeholders end-to-end assurance that the platform behaves correctly at every tier. Qualifications Minimum of 7+ years of related experience Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience Talents Needed For Success 7+ years of hands-on test automation engineering, ideally within complex, large-scale enterprise or financial platforms. Deep expertise in keyword-driven / data-driven automation frameworks, including designing, extending, and maintaining reusable framework components. Strong programming skills in a language such as Python, Java, or C# for building robust, maintainable automation. Proven experience automating across multiple layers — UI, REST/SOAP API, database, and end-to-end integration testing. Solid database and SQL proficiency, with practical experience validating data across relational systems (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and testing data migrations. Working knowledge of containerized, microservices architectures (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes) and testing in distributed, multi-service environments. Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab) for continuous testing. Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools for test generation, self-healing locators, or intelligent test maintenance is a strong plus. Prior experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and setting technical direction for a testing practice. Capital markets, post-trade, or broader financial services domain experience is highly desirable. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. Role Overview We are looking for a passionate Quality Engineer with strong software development, automation, and AI skills. You will build frameworks, tools, and intelligent solutions that improve product testability, accelerate defect detection, and enable quality throughout the software development lifecycle. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for desktop, web, API, and system-level testing. Develop reusable software tools, libraries, APIs, and utilities that improve testability and engineering productivity. Partner with developers to review designs, improve code testability, and drive Shift-Left quality practices. Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. Apply AI and intelligent algorithms to generate tests, analyze logs, identify failure patterns, and accelerate root cause analysis. Automate the collection, transformation, and reporting of test results and quality metrics. Build actionable dashboards using Power BI or similar reporting tools. Support DevOps, continuous testing, and release-readiness initiatives. Required Skills And Qualifications Strong software development experience using C#, Java, Python, TypeScript, or a similar programming language. Strong understanding of OOP, OOD, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean coding practices. Experience developing automation frameworks, developer tools, APIs, libraries, or test infrastructure. Experience with UI automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, WinAppDriver, or Coded UI. Experience with API testing frameworks such as RestAssured, Postman, SoapUI, JUnit, or TestNG. Knowledge of REST, SOAP, XML, JSON, SQL, Git, and web-service technologies. Experience integrating automated tests into Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms. Hands-on exposure to Generative AI, AI-assisted coding, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, intelligent test generation, or log and failure analysis using AI. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills. Good communication and collaboration skills. Minimum Qualifications Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years About KLA We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. Use of AI Statement At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees. title: Senior Quality Engineer
description: About NCR VOYIX NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Quality Engineer to own and drive end-to-end quality assurance across a modern retail/POS platform built on React UI, Go-based services, BFF (Backend for Frontend), and distributed microservices architecture. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in automation testing, API validation, database verification, CI/CD quality governance, and retail transaction workflows. This role requires strong technical troubleshooting, defect isolation, and automation leadership to ensure high-quality releases across business-critical retail systems. Job Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks across UI, API, service, and integration layers using modern QA tools and best practices. Build and maintain robust Playwright-based end-to-end automation covering key POS workflows such as checkout, tender processing, receipts, order management, and lane/device interactions. Perform comprehensive testing of REST and gRPC APIs, including contract validation, negative-path testing, integration validation, and service-level quality verification. Validate data integrity through extensive SQL Server testing, including complex query validation, stored procedure verification, data profiling, and backend business rule testing. Own quality gates within CI/CD pipelines by managing automated test execution, flaky test reduction, coverage enforcement, linting standards, and release readiness criteria. Troubleshoot and debug issues in Docker-based multi-service environments, identifying failures across frontend, BFF, backend services, and infrastructure dependencies. Develop and execute risk-based test strategies focused on critical retail business domains including payments, inventory management, customer engagement, loyalty programs, and order processing. Validate distributed system behavior across React applications, BFF layers, and microservices, ensuring seamless end-to-end functionality. Test and verify POS device and event integrations, including scanner, printer, cash drawer, and peripheral simulation scenarios. Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. Drive root cause analysis through detailed defect investigation using application logs, API traces, database evidence, and reproducible test scenarios. Ensure adherence to security and compliance requirements, including PII handling, authentication token validation, and PCI-sensitive transaction workflows. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or a related quality-focused role. Strong hands-on experience testing applications built with Go and React technology stacks. Proven expertise in automated testing across UI, API, integration, and service layers. Extensive experience with Playwright for end-to-end test automation and debugging. Strong knowledge of REST and gRPC API testing, including contract validation and negative test design. Advanced proficiency in SQL Server, including complex queries, joins, stored procedures, data validation, and test data analysis. Experience owning quality initiatives within CI/CD pipelines and release processes. Hands-on experience with Docker/Compose environments, service dependency troubleshooting, and containerized application testing. Demonstrated ability to create risk-based test plans aligned with business-critical workflows. Strong analytical, debugging, and defect isolation skills with evidence-driven problem-solving approaches. Experience validating distributed systems, microservices, and BFF architectures. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Retail, POS, Payments, Commerce, or Transaction Processing systems. Knowledge of POS device integration testing, including printers, scanners, payment terminals, and cash drawers. Understanding of security testing practices related to authentication, authorization, PII protection, and PCI compliance. Experience with observability and troubleshooting tools for distributed systems. Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence engineering teams and drive quality improvements across releases. This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake additional duties and projects that are consistent with their skills, capabilities, and the overall purpose of the position Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job EEO Statement Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.
